trigger.description: The distillation scope contained journal entries but none met the proposal thresholds: every entry was a low-signal note/observation, instruction-risk excluded, or already distilled. The run succeeds with an empty proposals[] array and an info-severity distill_no_candidates degraded entry — an honest empty result, not a failure (ADR 0062 §7).
setup_commands: ee journal append 'plain note with no failure signal' --workspace . --json

notes: Distillation only promotes command_failure clusters, first-seen failure shapes, and lone surprises; notes and observations abstain below_signal_threshold by design. Agents should treat this code as 'capture more failure/surprise evidence or widen --session/--agent/--since', never as an error to retry.
